info.title: NYALES M3 implemented local API
info.description: Implementation slice /api. Full /api/v1 product contract remains design. Local acceptance only; no cloud deployment. JSON request shapes generated from Zod runtime schemas; cross-field/permission/calendar/amount/state constraints enforced by server and regression tests. Responses intentionally use variable data envelope, not a fully typed SDK response contract. Read scope applies organization/area/hierarchy/channel/assignment; settings Management/NSM; order and target approvals independent. Monetary minor fields are whole IDR rupiah.

get.description: Scope/filters unchanged. SQL aggregates all eligible invoices and activities. sources are bounded compatibility previews (up to 50 each); source_pages declares total/has_more. KPI totals never derive from previews. workforce.observed_actual_minor is aggregated per rep and channel. Detailed lists use /api/dashboard/sources. Target and workforce groups remain limited to 2000; not a production capacity acceptance.

post.description: Management/NSM private report. Fetches the complete selected dataset independently of summary previews. Rejects >10000 rows or >5 MiB UTF-8 before storing the R2 object or report record; never silently truncates. Targets/workforce remain subject to their 2000-group guards. Existing idempotency/checksum/expiry and private download rules remain.

200.description: Authenticated private attachment; Content-Disposition attachment; no-store; nosniff

409.description: State, overlap, lease, idempotency or reference changed

get.description: Same organization/role/area/rep/team/branch/period filters as summary. covered applies only to customers, meaningful only to activities, source_channel only to activities or targets. Cursor bound to current identity, scope, cutoff, report filters and source selection; changing context requires restarting at page 1. Every request recomputes authorization. live_keyset is not a frozen export or snapshot. No-store. Unknown query keys and invalid filter combinations return 422.

200.description: One bounded page of current authorized source records

422.description: INVALID_REPORT_SOURCE_QUERY / INVALID_REPORT_CURSOR / FUTURE_PERIOD / AMOUNT_OVERFLOW / bounded target or workforce scope requires narrowing
